# Mignon UI

> The aesthetic, lightweight local AI roleplay client for multi-bot lobbies.

Mignon UI is a private, offline-first desktop frontend (Tauri + React) and web app for chatting with multiple AI characters simultaneously. It is designed as a distraction-free, beautifully styled alternative to complex cockpits like SillyTavern.

## Key Capabilities
- **Multi-Bot Lobbies:** Group chats where multiple AI characters converse with each other and the user naturally with turn-taking logic.
- **Ecosystem Compatibility:** Native import of Tavern character cards (.png V2) and World Lorebooks.
- **Local & Cloud AI Backends:** Out-of-the-box support for Local Ollama, Kobold.cpp (optimized for 6GB VRAM laptops via ContextShift), OpenRouter, and custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
- **Aesthetic Customization:** High-contrast aesthetic themes (Bubblegum Pop, Neo-Cyber, Dollhouse, Dark Yellow, Sketch Book) in light/dark modes.
- **Privacy & Security:** Stored in a local database on-device, zero telemetry, open source under AGPL-3.0.
